title: 很 + adjective
explanation: Adjectives in Chinese are stative verbs — they don't need 是. 很 before an adjective links the subject to the quality. 很 often weakens to "very" but is required grammatically in simple sentences.
notes: Never say 我是忙. For "not," drop 很: 我不忙 (not 我不很忙). For "really/very," use 真 or 非常: 真忙, 非常忙. 很 is the default neutral linker.
